item.title: SpaceX resumes Falcon 9 flights with Starlink satellite launch from California
item.description: A SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket carrying 25 Starlink satellites launched from Vandenberg Space Force Base in California on Feb. 7, 2025. The mission returned the Falcon to flight after an upper stage issue.
